8GB-VISION-DEFAULT-F16.label: ✅ Default: 16k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (ROCK SOLID)
8GB-VISION-DEFAULT-F16.description: DEFAULT STABLE: 16,384 tokens with full f16 KV cache + vision. Rock-solid stability, high precision. Best for production use.

8GB-VISION-ULTRA-F16.label: 🔥 Ultra F16: 32k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (MAX PRECISION)
8GB-VISION-ULTRA-F16.description: MAX PRECISION: 32,768 tokens with full f16 KV cache + vision. Note: may crash on idle due to llama.cpp bug. Use for high-quality single requests.

8GB-VISION-ULTRA.label: ⚡ Ultra: 36k ctx + IQ4_XS KV + Vision + SpecDecode
8GB-VISION-ULTRA.description: Maximum context with vision. IQ4_XS KV saves ~1.2GB vs f16. Speculative decoding with 1B draft model for ~2x token speed.

8GB-VISION-HIGH.label: 🚀 High: 32k ctx + IQ4_XS KV + Vision + FlashAttn v2
8GB-VISION-HIGH.description: Best balance for coding with vision. IQ4_XS KV saves ~1GB. FlashAttn v2 tuned for sm89.

8GB-VISION-BALANCED.label: ⚖️ Balanced: 28k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-BALANCED.description: Safe choice for vision workloads. q4_0 KV is stable and saves ~600MB vs f16.

8GB-VISION-SAFE.label: 🛡️ Safe: 24k ctx + q4_0 KV + Vision
8GB-VISION-SAFE.description: Conservative with large margin. For heavy vision + long context tasks.

8GB-CODE-MAX.label: 💻 Code Max: 48k ctx + IQ2_XS KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-MAX.description: Maximum context for code-only tasks. IQ2_XS KV saves ~1.8GB vs f16. SpecDecode for speed.

8GB-CODE-HIGH.label: 💻 Code High: 40k ctx + q4_0 KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-HIGH.description: High context coding without vision. q4_0 KV stable, saves ~600MB.

8GB-CODE-BALANCED.label: 💻 Code Balanced: 32k ctx + q8_0 KV (no vision)
8GB-CODE-BALANCED.description: Sweet spot for code tasks. q8_0 KV near-lossless, saves ~300MB vs f16.

8GB-CODE-FAST.label: ⚡ Code Fast: 16k ctx + f16 KV + SpecDecode
8GB-CODE-FAST.description: Maximum throughput for short-context coding. Large batch + SpecDecode = ~3x token speed.

8GB-RESEARCH.label: 🔬 Research: 64k ctx + IQ1_S KV (no vision, experimental)
8GB-RESEARCH.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Maximum context with ultra-low KV. May have quality degradation. For research only.

8GB-VISION-QUALITY.label: 🎨 Vision Quality: 32k ctx + f16 KV + Vision (best quality)
8GB-VISION-QUALITY.description: Best vision quality. f16 KV preserves full precision. Tight margin - monitor VRAM.
